description: This file contains functions for deriving and merging session origin data, group session patches, and session metadata patches within a messaging or chat application. It handles session context, group resolution, and related data transformations.

methods.name: mergeOrigin
methods.description: Merges two SessionOrigin objects, prioritizing non-undefined fields from the 'next' object.

methods.name: deriveSessionOrigin
methods.description: Derives a SessionOrigin object from a MsgContext, extracting label, provider, surface, chatType, from, to, accountId, and threadId.

methods.name: snapshotSessionOrigin
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the origin from a SessionEntry.

methods.name: deriveGroupSessionPatch
methods.description: Generates a partial SessionEntry for a group session based on context, existing session, and group resolution.

methods.name: deriveSessionMetaPatch
methods.description: Creates a patch for session metadata, combining group session patch and session origin.
